test_cases.stimulus: Fresh HELLO/OFFER/ACTIVATE/READY
test_cases.PC_expected: ACTIVE same new 128-bit epoch, counters zero
test_cases.FPGA_expected: ACTIVE with epoch accepted and counters zero once
test_cases.pass_oracle: No IQ/CPI state side effect

test_cases.stimulus: Drop OFFER/READY; retry HELLO/ACTIVATE
test_cases.PC_expected: Retry same epoch; never deliver application frames early
test_cases.FPGA_expected: Idempotently resend OFFER/READY without second counter reset
test_cases.pass_oracle: No duplicate SESSION transition

test_cases.stimulus: Old ACK epoch A seq0 while epoch B has outstanding seq0
test_cases.PC_expected: Ignore old ACK; continue waiting for B ACK
test_cases.FPGA_expected: Ignore old ACK before releasing replay
test_cases.pass_oracle: B replay remains unchanged until B ACK

test_cases.stimulus: Old-epoch reliable IQ/RESULT/STATUS with valid CRC
test_cases.PC_expected: No old result accepted
test_cases.FPGA_expected: Discard old epoch before seq/application effect
test_cases.pass_oracle: No IQ write, ghost commit or seq increment

test_cases.stimulus: Delayed ACK after retry; duplicate ACK, stale ACK; malformed ACK and NACK
test_cases.PC_expected: Only exact current ACK completes once
test_cases.FPGA_expected: NACK never releases buffer; reject old/future/mismatch
test_cases.pass_oracle: Outstanding replay safe and monotonic

test_cases.stimulus: Same-epoch COMMIT ACK lost
test_cases.PC_expected: Deduplicate identical COMMIT bytes/seq
test_cases.FPGA_expected: Repeat original identical COMMIT within approved retry policy
test_cases.pass_oracle: No contradictory ABORT after COMMIT

test_cases.stimulus: USB unplug after COMMIT received by PC but its ACK lost; FPGA retained tuple
test_cases.PC_expected: New epoch QUERY, validate prior COMMIT and release once
test_cases.FPGA_expected: OFFER retained COMMIT; new STATUS seq in new epoch; no ABORT
test_cases.pass_oracle: No double-commit, no old ACK acceptance

test_cases.stimulus: USB unplug after final RESULT but before COMMIT reaches host
test_cases.PC_expected: Keep provisional invalid until full matched COMMIT
test_cases.FPGA_expected: Offer retained terminal or preterminal state as actually known
test_cases.pass_oracle: No premature host acceptance

test_cases.stimulus: COMMIT retry exhaustion during link loss
test_cases.PC_expected: Await resolution, never assume FPGA abort
test_cases.FPGA_expected: TERMINAL_ACK_UNCERTAIN, unchanged terminal COMMIT and CPI_ID
test_cases.pass_oracle: No next CPI until release/recovery

test_cases.stimulus: QUERY returns COMMIT but host lost provisional records
test_cases.PC_expected: Explicit HOST_INCOMPLETE; never accept missing records
test_cases.FPGA_expected: Preserve immutable COMMIT; release disposition needs approval
test_cases.pass_oracle: No silent partial result acceptance

test_cases.stimulus: FPGA power loss during COMMIT ACK wait, host no COMMIT
test_cases.PC_expected: UNKNOWN/NOT_ACCEPTED and explicit recovery
test_cases.FPGA_expected: OFFER NO_RETAINED_STATE; no historical COMMIT/ABORT
test_cases.pass_oracle: Require fresh IQ after RECOVER_UNKNOWN approval

test_cases.stimulus: FPGA power loss after valid host COMMIT before RELEASE
test_cases.PC_expected: Keep durable host-validated result if available; mark FPGA state unverified
test_cases.FPGA_expected: OFFER NO_RETAINED_STATE, never retroactive ABORT
test_cases.pass_oracle: No forged device terminal history

test_cases.stimulus: Delayed SESSION_HELLO/OFFER/READY from prior epoch
test_cases.PC_expected: Accept only newly generated PC epoch echoed correctly
test_cases.FPGA_expected: Quarantine old application/ACK traffic; no silent state wipe
test_cases.pass_oracle: State protection limitations logged after POR

test_cases.stimulus: RELEASE wrong CPI ID/count/outcome, duplicate RELEASE, lost ACK
test_cases.PC_expected: Reject mismatches; resend identical RELEASE if ACK lost
test_cases.FPGA_expected: No clearing unrelated CPI; retain idempotent tombstone
test_cases.pass_oracle: Release only on matched decision and accepted disposition

test_cases.stimulus: QUERY while COMMIT outstanding, then new epoch
test_cases.PC_expected: Old epoch ack/retry S; new epoch QUERY with new seq Q
test_cases.FPGA_expected: Old S exact; after new epoch, new STATUS seq T preserving outcome
test_cases.pass_oracle: No out-of-order reliable reply or status mutation

test_cases.stimulus: DSP reset during COMMIT, UART parser reset in frame, global reset during IQ
test_cases.PC_expected: No unjustified commit; retry according to retained epoch only
test_cases.FPGA_expected: Protect terminal in DSP reset, discard partial parser bytes, POR loses state
test_cases.pass_oracle: No partial CPI run or false terminal PASS

test_cases.stimulus: Counter near wrap, reused epoch token, random source failure
test_cases.PC_expected: Do not initiate application data; acquire fresh epoch or fail
test_cases.FPGA_expected: Reject unsupported wrap/reused epoch where tracked
test_cases.pass_oracle: No stale ACK accepted as new

test_cases.stimulus: PC wants FRESH while FPGA retains another CPI_ID
test_cases.PC_expected: Reconcile existing CPI; reject mismatch
test_cases.FPGA_expected: OFFER actual retained ID without overwrite
test_cases.pass_oracle: Never silently lose old CPI

test_cases.stimulus: 35x488 IQ chunks, 35x484 readback aligned, 88 result packets x<=8
test_cases.PC_expected: Exact raw bytes and oracle records before COMMIT
test_cases.FPGA_expected: Strict epoch/CRC/seq/offset/ACK checks; no partial RUN
test_cases.pass_oracle: Full 16896 bytes and 702 records in candidate protocol

test_cases.stimulus: Unknown STAGE_REQUEST for unapproved seven DSP schemas
test_cases.PC_expected: Reject unknown schema; do not assign guessed format
test_cases.FPGA_expected: Return explicit unsupported/error without data mutation
test_cases.pass_oracle: All seven stage schemas remain OPEN
